proof.rejectDescription: The customer gets your reason by email and can send new proof.

insertHint.landlord: Signed for you with your business signature

Signing.withdrawn: Signature request withdrawn. The contract can be edited again.
Signing.lockedTitle: This contract was sent for signature
Signing.lockedPending: What the customer signs must be what was sent, so it can't be edited. Withdraw the request to change it, then send it again.
Signing.lockedCompleted: It has been signed by both parties and can no longer change.
Signing.pdfMissing: The PDF of this document isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.
Signing.signDescription: Your signature goes in every place marked for you. Draw it, type it, or upload a picture of it.
Signing.consent: I have read this document and agree to sign it electronically. My electronic signature is as binding as a handwritten one.
Signing.signedToast: Signed. A copy signed by both parties is ready to download.
Signing.completedDescription: This document is complete. Download the PDF to keep a copy; it ends with the audit trail.

certificate.title: Signing certificate
certificate.note: Signed electronically. The SHA-256 fingerprint identifies the exact content that was sent and signed; any change to it would change the fingerprint.

SignaturePad.uploadHint: Click to upload a picture of your signature
SignaturePad.uploadInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image up to 5 MB.

SignatureSettings.title: Business signature
SignatureSettings.description: Contracts you send for signature are signed with it on your business's behalf, wherever a landlord signature field is placed.
SignatureSettings.emptyOwner: Add one to send contracts for signature: they're signed for your business as they go out.
SignatureSettings.emptyCollaborator: The owner of the business hasn't set one up yet. Contracts can't be sent for signature until they do.
SignatureSettings.signerNameHint: Printed under the signature, e.g. the business's legal representative.
